name: tenant-isolation-and-authorization

membership_revocation.interpretation: Revocation is enforced after the documented cache TTL; a warm isolate may continue authorizing until that entry expires. This is an observed bounded stale-authorization window, not immediate revocation.

covered_paths: Space Assistant and Project Bot authorization with real local D1 membership rows
cross-tenant Space read boundary in both directions
blackboard paging and visibility snapshot behavior
wake authorization revocation before AgentDO dispatch
durable wake contention and expired-lease behavior
AgentDO process restart recovery without blind redispatch
limitations: No remote Cloudflare deployment, live provider call, or production identity provider was exercised.
No test asserts immediate membership revocation; local runtime confirms a warm-cache allow can remain for up to the documented 5000ms TTL.
Account signup, password recovery, session rotation, and tenant deletion lifecycle remain outside this batch.
